Equipment:1000kg ELEVATORS

Speed 
 1 m/s

Introduction

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, to be performed on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The 
first draft initiated by eng. Wgdy Roshdy Habeb, tested by eng. 
Samy Shehata, accepted by eng. Hany Fahmy Madny; 
general manager, 
approved by eng. Abd El Kerim Abu Zeid Ismail Head Sector of High Dam Hydraulic 
Power Station, and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem: HPGC quality control 
general director, and MPIS Coordinator.
Safety Precautions

A 
work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Wear safety and healthy equipment as helmet, 
safety shoes, ... etc.

Stop the Elevator and switch off the power 
supply.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Set of common screw drivers, wrenches

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Check up the oil in the 
machine and motor bearing.

Adjust the machine oil 
level or change it if necessary.

Adjust the motor bearing 
oil level if necessary.

Check up the brake and 
change the brake shoes if necessary.

Clean the machine parts 
and its items from outside.

Grease the machine parts 
and the pulleys machine room.

Clean the cabin guides and 
oil it.
Check up the doors.

Check up the rope belts on 
the cabinet.

Check up the stop of 
cabinet in all elevations.

Operate the elevator with 
full load and readjust the stopping of the cabinet in the floors.
